source_bindings.source: (let [s '#{nil false true 3 :key x "x" \x}] [(count s) (contains? s :key) (contains? s 'x) (vec (seq s))])
(let [s '#{'x (quote y) (1 2) (3 "z")}] [(count s) (contains? s '(quote y)) (contains? s '(1 2)) (vec (seq s))])
(let [s '#{nil false true -2 1.5 :ns/key 'ns/name "Aa" "BB" \z [1] {:x 2}}] [(count s) (contains? s nil) (contains? s :ns/key) (contains? s '(quote ns/name)) (vec (seq s))])

(let [events (atom []) s #{(do (swap! events conj :first) 1) (do (swap! events conj :second) "a") (do (swap! events conj :third) \b)} output (with-out-str (println (count s)))] [(count s) (vec (seq s)) @events output])

(let [events (atom []) f (fn* [x] (swap! events conj x) x) s #{(f 0) (f 1) (f 2) (f 3) (f 4) (f 5) (f 6) (f 7) (f 8) (f 9) (f 10) (f 11) (f 12) (f 13) (f 14) (f 15)} output (with-out-str (println (count s)))] [(count s) (contains? s 0) (contains? s 15) @events output])

(let [events (atom []) f (fn* [x] (swap! events conj x) x) s #{(f 0) (f 1) (f 2) (f 3) (f 4) (f 5) (f 6) (f 7) (f 8) (f 9) (f 10) (f 11) (f 12) (f 13) (f 14) (f 15)} output (with-out-str (println (count s)))] [(count s) (contains? s 0) (contains? s 15) (vec (seq s)) @events output])
